that’s right phrase

also exactly!, quite so, just so, that is exactly what I think

classical

Traupman 107, 109

Sīc est.

Other words

  • Ita est.

    also used · classical · Traupman 107, 109

  • Ita prōrsus. — exactly, quite so

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 2.67: Ita prōrsus; Cic. Tusc. 1.11: Ita prōrsus exīstimō.

    Cicero names Admodum and Prōrsus ita est as the replies said in conversation to let it move on (Leg. 3.26, quoted by Lewis & Short, s.v. admodum).

  • Rēctē dīcis. — that’s right, you’re right

    also used · classical · Plaut. Men. 2.3.74: hercle quīn tū rēctē dīcis (Lewis & Short s.v. regō); Traupman 182

    (vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Plaut.)

See also you’re right, I think so, yes.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 107, 109.
